title: Wnt/beta-catenin inhibitor pyrivinium attenuates cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury by possibly reducing platinum uptake and accumulation mediated by reduced organic cation transporter-2 expressions.
authors: Pandey, Sneha; Gupta, Kirti; Bagang, Newly; Singh, Gaaminepreet; Rajput, Sakshi
journal: Canadian journal of physiology and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Wnt/β-catenin抑制剂对顺铂肾毒性的保护作用，涉及OCT-2蛋白表达与对接，但核心是肾损伤药理，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与课题无关。
abstract: Aberrant activation of Wnt/beta-catenin induces renal dysfunction by initiating pro-apoptotic cascades, fibrosis, oxidative and inflammatory burden. This study tested the therapeutic effects of Wnt/beta-catenin inhibitor pyrvinium against cisplatin-induced acute kidney injury (AKI) in rats. Cisplatin was administered at a single dose of 5 mg/kg (i.p.) and renal cisplatin accumulation and uptake in cortical slices were determined after the fifth day by atomic absorption spectroscopy. Levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines were checked by ELISA, and organic cation transporter-2 (OCT-2) transcription and expression in renal tissue were evaluated by RT-PCR and immunohistochemical technique. Cisplatin administration produced renal dysfunction manifested as increase in serum creatinine, blood urea nitrogen, proteinuria, reduced clearance and electrolyte imbalance. Oxidative stress indices, pro-inflammatory cytokines, fibronectin, and caspase-3 activity were elevated in cisplatin-challenged rats. Moreover, increased renal OCT-2 transcription and immunostaining were detected in cisplatin kidneys which resulted in platinum accumulation. Additional docking studies depicted strong interaction between the beta-catenin and OCT-2 protein. These manifestations induced mitochondrial dysfunction, histological damage and fibrosis. Notably, Wnt/beta-catenin inhibitor pyrvinium (60 microg/kg; p.o.) treatment reduced the renal OCT-2 gene transcription causing a decline in platinum levels. Thus, the present study concludes that Wnt/beta-catenin inhibition attenuates cisplatin-induced AKI in rats, partly by down-regulating OCT-2 expression.
abstract_zh: Wnt/beta-catenin的异常激活通过启动促凋亡级联反应、纤维化、氧化和炎症负担诱导肾功能障碍。本研究测试了Wnt/beta-catenin抑制剂pyrvinium对大鼠顺铂诱导的急性肾损伤（AKI）的治疗效果。以单剂量5 mg/kg（腹腔注射）给予顺铂，并在第五天后通过原子吸收光谱法测定肾皮质切片中的顺铂积累和摄取。通过ELISA检查促炎细胞因子水平，并通过RT-PCR和免疫组织化学技术评估肾组织中有机阳离子转运蛋白-2（OCT-2）的转录和表达。顺铂给药产生肾功能障碍，表现为血清肌酐、血尿素氮、蛋白尿增加，清除率降低和电解质失衡。在顺铂攻击的大鼠中，氧化应激指标、促炎细胞因子、纤连蛋白和caspase-3活性升高。此外，在顺铂肾脏中检测到肾OCT-2转录和免疫染色的增加，这导致铂积累。额外的对接研究显示了beta-catenin与OCT-2蛋白之间的强相互作用。这些表现诱导线粒体功能障碍、组织学损伤和纤维化。值得注意的是，Wnt/beta-catenin抑制剂pyrvinium（60微克/千克；口服）治疗减少了肾OCT-2基因转录，导致铂水平下降。因此，本研究得出结论，Wnt/beta-catenin抑制通过部分下调OCT-2表达减轻顺铂诱导的大鼠AKI。
